Container.Name: Typr-Companion
Container.Overview: Native TeX Live 2026 LaTeX with a persistent package cache, automatic missing-package installation, TeXpresso, scoped workspace, and authenticated management for Typr. Projects are stateless by default; trusted LAN/VPN use only and never expose it publicly.
Container.Description: Typr Companion is installed separately from the browser-local Typr PWA. It runs native latexmk/pdfLaTeX and experimental TeXpresso. Its separately authenticated management GUI shows services and activity and manages service users/API keys. On stock Unraid kernels without Landlock, the template offers an explicit stateless fallback and a separate fallback for one scoped workspace. Browser projects remain authoritative. The trusted-workspace fallback warns that native compiler processes may access the mapped files; enable it only for mutually trusted users and documents. No broad share or appdata root belongs here. The service API starts without required API keys for compatibility and must never be exposed to the public Internet.
Container.Changes: 2026-09-01: Add pinned TeX Live 2026, persistent automatic package installation, and reliable Landlock compilation.
Container.Requires: Use only on a trusted LAN or private VPN with mutually trusted documents. Never expose either port to the public Internet. Choose a unique management password of at least 24 characters; use trusted HTTPS when the management network is not physically trusted. Remote Typr use requires a client-trusted HTTPS reverse proxy with WebSocket support and firewall/VPN restriction. For Tailscale, keep the container's Use Tailscale switch off and use host-level Tailscale Serve; never use Funnel. The dedicated TeX cache path is required and must not contain unrelated files or secrets. Stock Unraid may use the explicit stateless fallback with only that TeX cache mounted. A mapped workspace remains fail-closed by default when Landlock is unavailable; its separate trusted-workspace fallback must be set exactly to 1 and means native compiler processes may access mapped files.

Config.Name: Companion port
Config.Description: Host port used by the reverse proxy and local status checks. Container port must remain 8484.

Config.Name: Management GUI port
Config.Description: Host port for the management GUI. Container port must remain 8485. Keep it restricted to a trusted LAN/VPN and never expose it publicly.

Config.Name: Management listen address
Config.Description: Required container listen address for the mapped GUI port. Keep 0.0.0.0 in bridge mode; remote mode refuses startup without a strong management password.

Config.Name: Management password
Config.Description: Required administrator password for the GUI; at least 24 characters. The browser username is typr. This is separate from service API keys.

Config.Name: Allowed Typr origins
Config.Description: Comma-separated exact browser origins, including scheme, host, and port with no path or trailing slash. Add the self-hosted Typr origin. CORS is not authentication.

Config.Name: TeX Live package cache
Config.Description: Dedicated persistent cache for the pinned TeX Live runtime and packages installed on demand. UID 1000 needs read/write access. Do not store projects, secrets, or unrelated files here.

Config.Name: Allow stateless Unraid fallback
Config.Description: Keep exactly 1 on stock Unraid: if Landlock is unavailable, allow trusted-document compilation only when no host workspace is mounted.

Config.Name: Allow trusted workspace fallback
Config.Description: Set exactly 1 only when all users and documents are trusted and Landlock is unavailable. Compiler processes may access the mapped workspace. Leave blank to fail closed.

Config.Name: Workspace directory
Config.Description: Optional one exact dedicated project directory. Never map /, /mnt, /mnt/user, a broad share, appdata root, symlinked root, or the Docker socket. UID 1000 needs read/write access.

Config.Name: Workspace API root
Config.Description: Set exactly /workspace only when Workspace directory is configured. Leave blank to disable the file API.

Config.Name: Workspace ID
Config.Description: Stable opaque letters/numbers/dot/underscore/hyphen identifier for browser bindings; never put a host path here. Ignored while the API root is blank.

Config.Name: Workspace maximum file bytes
Config.Description: Maximum bytes allowed for one workspace file. Increase only when large project assets require it; reverse proxies must accept the larger base64 request body.

Config.Name: Workspace maximum entries
Config.Description: Maximum number of regular files in the mapped workspace.

Config.Name: Workspace maximum total bytes
Config.Description: Maximum total bytes across regular files in the mapped workspace. Must be at least the maximum file bytes.
